Isolation disconnects equipment from every source of electrical energy, so the worker removes the hazard instead of just managing it."},{"text":"It reduces the electrical hazard to a safer level while leaving some energy sources connected.","correct":false,"feedback":"This is incorrect because isolation disconnects equipment from every source of electrical energy, not just some sources, eliminating the hazard rather than reducing it."},{"text":"It allows work to continue safely while the equipment remains connected to its energy source.","correct":false,"feedback":"This is incorrect because isolation requires disconnecting equipment from all electrical energy sources before work begins, not keeping it connected."},{"text":"It manages the hazard by monitoring the equipment closely during the work process.","correct":false,"feedback":"This is incorrect because isolation removes the hazard entirely rather than managing it through monitoring."}],"evidenceIds":["ev-s8","ev-s10"]}
